capabilities: Map any Obsidian command to a left or right two-finger trackpad swipe
Adjust swipe sensitivity and horizontal dominance thresholds
Invert swipe direction if the mapping feels reversed
Filter macOS momentum scrolling so commands fire on finger lift
Show a visual half-circle indicator when a swipe triggers
extras: Desktop only (trackpad/mouse); installed by cloning into the vault's plugin folder with main.js included, no build step required; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bind trackpad swipe gestures to commands, and browser wheel events fire during macOS inertia scrolling, making gesture triggers unreliable.
summary: Trackpad gesture plugin that maps two-finger horizontal swipes to any Obsidian command, defaulting to back/forward navigation.
